  {"step": 6, "file": "src/TopicTree.h", "function": "TopicTree::drain", "line": 253, "var": "drainableSubscribers", "code": "if (drainableSubscribers == s) { drainableSubscribers = nullptr; }", "note": "Chunk5: drain(0x43535300) is called. Since 0x43535300 is the head and has next=0x20202020, the head is reset to nullptr, ORPHANING 0x20202020 which still has numMessageIndices=1 and messageIndices[0]=0 but is no longer reachable in the list."},

  {"step": 8, "file": "src/TopicTree.h", "function": "TopicTree::publish", "line": 306, "var": "s->numMessageIndices", "code": "s->messageIndices[s->numMessageIndices++] = (uint16_t)outgoingMessages.size();", "note": "Chunks 24-25: 2 more publishes to '%' bring orphaned 0x20202020's numMessageIndices to 20; its messageIndices[0..19] reference the current outgoingMessages (size 20)."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src/TopicTree.h", "function": "TopicTree::drain", "line": 274, "var": "outgoingMessages", "code": "drainableSubscribers = nullptr; outgoingMessages.clear();", "note": "Chunk26: drain() (no-arg) drains the only listed subscriber 0x43535300, then clears outgoingMessages. Orphaned 0x20202020 is NOT drained, so its messageIndices[0..19] become stale indices into the now-empty vector."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "src/TopicTree.h", "function": "TopicTree::publish", "line": 306, "var": "s->numMessageIndices", "code": "s->messageIndices[s->numMessageIndices++] = (uint16_t)outgoingMessages.size();", "note": "Chunks 27-38: 12 publishes to '%' re-populate outgoingMessages to size 12 and raise orphaned 0x20202020's numMessageIndices to 32."},
  {"step": 11, "file": "src/TopicTree.h", "function": "TopicTree::publish", "line": 302, "var": "s", "code": "if (s->numMessageIndices == 32) { drain(s); }", "note": "Chunk39: publish sees numMessageIndices==32 and calls drain(0x20202020), which invokes drainImpl and iterates messageIndices[0..31]."},
  {"step": 12, "file": "src/TopicTree.h", "function": "TopicTree::drainImpl", "line": 119, "var": "outgoingMessage", "code": "T &outgoingMessage = outgoingMessages[s->messageIndices[i]];", "note": "drainImpl reads outgoingMessages[messageIndices[i]]. Stale indices 12..19 exceed outgoingMessages.size()==12, so the reference points past the vector's live elements (container-overflow)."},
  {"step": 13, "file": "fuzzing/TopicTree.cpp", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput::$_0::operator()", "line": 18, "var": "message", "code": "if (!message.length()) { free((void *) -1); }", "note": "The callback reads message.length() on the out-of-bounds std::string reference, triggering ASAN container-overflow READ of size 1 (crash address 0x6170000001a0)."}
]
EOF
